newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 29.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Socialist party leader Lional Jospin says in an interview the centre-right coalition is "confused", says his party backs Europe's planned single currency, adds socialist call for a 35-hour work week would rely on a three-year schedule and negotiations with social partners.

-- Air France posts a 211-million-francs profit for year to March 31, 1997, its first profit since 1989. Turnover rose by more than eight percent to 42.4 billion francs, but the impact of a merger with the former Air Inter on the company's accounts remain unknown.

-- Agri-food group Danone signs agreement with international food sector union, committing itself to including unions in talks of restructuring and layoff plans for all the countries in which it operates.
